correctness.rationale: All three dot products yield exact necessary and sufficient inequalities. Pointwise h² endpoint strips have lengths (1-t)²/L and (1-q)²/L. The bound m_h/h² <= 6/(q+t), integrable on the unit square, justifies the coefficient 8 log(2)/3 - 7/6. Mark densities have common bounded z support and an integrable 1/(q+t) majorant, proving total variation after conditioning. Finite-h interval formulas and independent dot-product tests passed; no finite simulation is offered as a proof of an infinite limit.

value.rationale: The natural acute-triangle event under one-point-per-side stratified sampling of a degenerating host has a distinct h² law, unlike the logarithmic h² log(1/h) under two nearby thin sampling models. The exact coefficient and complete signed conditional total-variation law reveal two separate coincidence boundary layers and their side-parameter dependence, motivating the precise invariant and its further use in thin geometry.
